description: This file defines symbol naming conventions and utility functions for symbolic expressions used in PyTorch's internal modules, particularly for tensor shape and index management within torch.fx.experimental.symbolic_shapes and torch._inductor.

classes.name: SymT
classes.description: Enumeration of different symbol types used for tensor shape and index representations.

methods.name: make_symbol
methods.description: Creates a sympy.Symbol with a prefix based on the SymT enum and an index.

methods.name: symbol_is_type
methods.description: Checks if a sympy.Symbol's name starts with the prefix associated with a given SymT or set of SymT types.

methods.name: free_symbol_is_type
methods.description: Checks if any free symbols in a sympy expression match a given SymT or set of SymT types.
